desc:
Booking calls and demos from chat means your sales assistant offers real free times and puts the meeting in your calendar. Ecom Swift LLC connects the assistant to your calendar tool, so a ready buyer books in the same conversation instead of filling in a contact form.

## What is chat booking, and why does it matter?

Chat booking is a feature that lets a visitor choose a call or demo time inside the conversation, with the slot checked against your live calendar. The visitor never leaves the page, never waits for an email reply and never plays calendar tennis with your team.

Without it, the moment of highest interest often ends in a form that nobody answers until the next morning. By then the buyer has opened three other tabs. A booking that happens while the person is still curious is far more likely to turn into a real conversation.

## How booking from chat improves leads and sales calls

The mechanism is simple: fewer steps between interest and a confirmed meeting. Every extra step, such as a form, a wait or a back and forth about times, gives the buyer a reason to drift away. Booking in chat removes those steps and gives your team a firm commitment on the calendar.

It also improves the quality of the call. When the assistant asks a few questions first, such as what the visitor wants to discuss or which product they are considering, your team arrives prepared. Fewer no shows follow when the buyer receives a confirmation and a reminder with a clear reschedule link. Your outcomes still depend on your offer, your team and your follow up, but the booking path stops being the weak point.

## What a good chat booking setup includes

- A direct link between the chat and your calendar tool, so only genuinely free times are shown.
- Meeting types with clear names, such as a product demo, a quote call or a support session.
- Buffer time before and after each call so your team is never double booked back to back.
- Pre call questions that collect the context your team needs.
- A confirmation email with the date, time, meeting link and a reschedule option.
- A reminder email sent ahead of the call.
- Time zone display that shows the buyer their own local time.
- Working hours and blocked days that match how your team really works.
- Routing between team members when more than one person takes calls.
- A follow up message when someone does not show up.

## How we set it up

We start by reviewing your calendar tool, your meeting types and who takes which kind of call. Then we connect the assistant, write the wording it uses to offer times and set the questions it asks before the call.

Next comes the careful part. We book test calls from different time zones, reschedule them, cancel them and check that each email arrives with the right details. The Basic package covers one meeting type with confirmation. Standard adds more meeting types, buffers, questions and reminders. Premium covers team calendars, round robin routing, a no show follow up and a period of adjustments after launch.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Offer only the meeting types you can truly staff.
- Keep pre call questions short, two or three at most.
- Set buffers so your team has time to prepare and breathe.
- Test a booking from a phone before you announce the feature.
- Tell the visitor exactly what happens after they confirm.

**Avoid:**
- Showing every open hour of the week, which overwhelms the buyer.
- Asking for a long list of details before offering a time.
- Mixing personal and work calendars without checking what is visible.
- Leaving the old contact form as the only route when the buyer prefers to talk.
- Skipping the reminder email, which is where many no shows start.

## Who this is for

This fits an online store that sells high value or custom products and wants buyers to talk to a specialist before they order. It suits a B2B supplier who offers product demos or wholesale calls. It also suits a service business, such as an installer or consultant, that wants quote calls booked without phone tag.

If your team is a single person with one calendar, the setup is quick. If several people share the load, we configure routing so calls are spread fairly.

## What we need from you

Send the name of your calendar tool, the meeting types you want to offer, your usual working hours and the questions you want asked before a call. Tell us who should receive each type of booking.

We work inside your own accounts and never need your passwords. Access is given as a collaborator, team member or developer user where the platform supports it, and you can remove it whenever you like. After you order, we reply with a short checklist and keep you updated until the first real booking comes through.
